sentence: Tracks a group shirt order by size, color and quantity against a minimum count, with sure or maybe flags and a running price total.
use_when: A group is ordering custom shirts and needs to reach a minimum quantity
Everyone needs to add their size, color and count in one place
The group wants to see how many shirts are sure versus maybe and the total cost
dont_use_when: Splitting a bill or tracking who owes whom
Voting on a design or choosing between options
Ordering items with many different products or custom prices
